document_clean:
Care Card: Peace Lily

Water your peace lily once a week, and let the top of the soil dry out between waterings. Its leaves will droop when it is thirsty.

Keep it out of direct sunlight; bright, indirect light is best.

Wipe the leaves with a damp cloth every month to remove dust. Repot it every two years in spring.
